items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: eventually I got to working with Dud Bascomb’s band, the trumpet player with Erskine Hawkins.

ctx.x: The Top Club, and some gigs at the Baby Grand, and some gigs at Smalls Paradise. They used to have entertainers. I got to playing in these clubs, and eventually I got to working with Dud Bascomb’s band, the trumpet player with Erskine Hawkins. He got a band, and we started working out in New Jersey, not too far from the prison out there, at a place called the Chicken Shack.
